what_went_wrong: The gpt-oss:20b draft treated travel-blog snippets as data. great_answer_would: Name Lagoa da Conceição and Campeche as the two that meet all four criteria with a line each, give runners-up with the one reason each fails (Jurerê pricey/dead off-season, Centro no beach, Canasvieiras car-dependent), then six-month practicalities (temporada contract or monthly Airbnb, CPF/guarantor, condo+IPTU, Dec-Feb doubling) in under 250 words.
